title: Hawaiian Xtreme Sports TV
description: Checking out giant waves at Sandy Beach; joining the Junior Lifeguard Championships on Maui; finding out who the new Duke Kahanamoku Hall of fame inductees are.

title: Ocean Paddler TV
description: Cross the Pailolo Channel from Maui to Molokai in blasting winds during the Pailolo Challenge.

title: Cooking Hawaiian Style
description: He's been a recording artist, radio personality and state senator. Brickwood Galuteria has been entertaining everyone throughout his adult life. And now he serves everyone a dish of his sausage and clams.

title: Hawaii Skin Diver
description: Hawaii Skin Divers head south of the border to La Paz, Mexico on a Red Sea Ocean Adventure to target the prized red snapper.

title: Sports People Hawaii
description: See how University of Hawaii pitcher Harrison Kuroda is developing the next generation of arms at his Pitching Performance Hawaii center. Check in with the University of Hawaii Racing Team and see how they fared against some of the top universities.
